pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
rank centres by how much their turnout percentage dropped between the two years, worst first
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS centre,
        "Month",
        "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled_2023,
        "Avg Daily Present" AS avg_present_2023,
        NULL AS enrolled_2024,
        NULL AS avg_present_2024
    FROM "attendance_2023"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS centre,
        "month",
        NULL AS enrolled_2023,
        NULL AS avg_present_2023,
        "enrolment" AS enrolled_2024,
        "average_attendance" AS avg_present_2024
    FROM "attendance_2024"
),

monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT
        centre,
        month,
        enrolled_2023,
        avg_present_2023,
        enrolled_2024,
        avg_present_2024,
        CASE
            WHEN enrolled_2023 IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (avg_present_2023 * 100.0) / NULLIF(enrolled_2023, 0)
        END AS turnout_2023,
        CASE
            WHEN enrolled_2024 IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (avg_present_2024 * 100.0) / NULLIF(enrolled_2024, 0)
        END AS turnout_2024
    FROM combined
),

centre_stats AS (
    SELECT
        centre,
        AVG(turnout_2023) AS avg_turnout_2023,
        AVG(turnout_2024) AS avg_turnout_2024
    FROM monthly_stats
    WHERE turnout_2023 IS NOT NULL AND turnout_2024 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY centre
)

SELECT
    centre,
    avg_turnout_2023,
    avg_turnout_2024,
    (avg_turnout_2024 - avg_turnout_2023) AS turnout_drop_pp
FROM centre_stats
ORDER BY turnout_drop_pp ASC
```
